resources.string: Waiting for an internet connection to Telegram…
Telemedia uses your Telegram account; the login stays on this phone. Type your Telegram phone number: Telegram sends a code to your Telegram app.
Telegram sent a code to your Telegram app (chat “Telegram”). Type it here:
Telegram sent you a code by SMS. Type it here:
Your Telegram account has a password. Type it to continue.
Logged in ✔\n\nNow getting your own Telegram API key (about a minute). Telegram sends a “login code” message to your “Telegram” chat: nothing to do, Telemedia reads it.
Almost done: switching to your own API key…
Telemedia needs your own Telegram API key, from my.telegram.org. Type your phone number: Telegram sends a code to your Telegram app.
Telegram sent a code to your Telegram app (chat “Telegram”, message “Web login code”). Type it here:
Getting your API key from Telegram…
I already have an api_id and api_hash
Telemedia finds videos in the groups and channels you are in. Join some now to have videos right away. You can leave them anytime in Telegram.
Opens Stremio\'s website: log in there with the same Stremio account as the Stremio app on this phone (and your TV), and confirm. Then come back here.
Added to your Stremio account ✔ Now open Stremio on this phone. If Telemedia isn\'t there, Stremio on this phone uses another account: tap Add to Stremio again and log in with that one.
Waiting for you to confirm on the Stremio page…
Adding Telemedia to your Stremio account…
No web browser found to open Stremio\'s page.
Open Stremio, pick a movie or an episode, and choose a Telemedia stream.\n\nTelemedia keeps running in the background (see the notification) and starts with the phone.
Use on a TV or computer

Stremio on a TV or computer on the same Wi-Fi can play from this phone. Tap Connect a TV: on the page that opens, log in to that TV\'s Stremio account and confirm, or the TV\'s owner scans the code with their own phone. Done with that TV? Tap Remove from Stremio account.
TV\'s owner: scan this with your phone and confirm in your Stremio account.
Or add this address in Stremio on the TV (Add-ons, search box):
Remove Telemedia from which Stremio account?
Remove Telemedia from %1$s? The phone gets a new key, so TVs on that account can\'t use it anymore. Your other connected accounts are updated by themselves.
Removed ✔ The old address no longer works.
Connected to %1$s ✔ Stremio on that TV now lists Telemedia. Keep the phone on this Wi-Fi (and charging) while you watch.
Smart-TV Stremio apps (Hisense VIDAA, LG, Samsung) need the secure (https) address, and it isn\'t ready yet. Telemedia keeps trying. Android TV and computers work now.
This network\'s router blocks the secure (https) address (DNS protection), so smart-TV Stremio apps (VIDAA, LG, Samsung) can\'t use it here. Android TV and computers work.
Connect the phone to Wi-Fi to use Telemedia on a TV.
The Stremio session of an account marked ⚠ has ended: tap Connect another TV and log in to that account again, or remove it.
Let Telemedia run in the background, so videos don\'t stop while you watch.
Stop Telemedia? Stremio on this phone and on your TVs can\'t play from it until you start it again. It stays stopped after a restart of the phone too.
Nothing runs in the background. Stremio on this phone and on your TVs can\'t play from it until you start it again.
Log this phone out of Telegram? Telemedia also leaves the Stremio accounts of the TVs it\'s connected to, so whoever logs in next doesn\'t get them.
Streams your Telegram videos to Stremio
